name: How long does the framing phase of a remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the framing phase of a remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the framing phase varies significantly based on the project's size and complexity. A small remodel involving a few non-load-bearing walls might take a few days. A larger project, such as a major room addition or a whole-house structural reconfiguration, could take several weeks. Factors like demolition, weather conditions, inspection schedules, and the availability of materials and crew also influence the timeline. Your contractor will provide a more precise estimate after assessing your specific remodel plans.
